description: RC4 KEY8/KEY32 addr macros: + -> | on disjoint bitfields, ptxas folds to single LOP3, shortens addr->load latency chain (+5.8%)

rc4_init_128: hoist 16 key-byte extractions out of KSA loop (match rc4_init_40/72/104 style); value-identical. -0.2% (1109.3->1106.9), within noise -> ptxas already LICM-hoists these; no-op. KSA is at op-count roofline (2 LDS+2 STS/byte, per-thread bank-conflict-free, addr already folded to 1 LOP3), MD5 off-limits, redundant-shared-load a documented non-win -> m9700 near roofline

RC4 PRGA (rc4_next_16): inline swap + reuse loaded sa/sb so idx=sa+sb, dropping the 2 post-swap shared reads/byte that ptxas cannot CSE (store intervenes, unlike the KSA which is at 2LDS+2STS roofline). Value-identical (verified: post-swap S[a]+S[b]==sa+sb, incl a==b). +0.74% (1109.3->1117.5) within ~1-2% noise: PRGA is only 32 keystream bytes vs 256 KSA swaps + 9 MD5 transforms/candidate, so the op cut is real but sub-noise on total runtime. RC4 PRGA lever exhausted for m9700; kernel MD5+KSA dominated.

m9700 a3 __launch_bounds__(FIXED_LOCAL_SIZE=32, 10): ncu proved kernel is LATENCY-bound not roofline (SM & mem BOTH only 64.08%, occ 16.6%, register-limited to 8 blocks/SM ~255 regs/thread, block=1 warp). Scoped KERNEL_FA override (CUDA/HIP) forces ptxas to trim regs to fit 10 blocks/SM (~204 regs) -> occ 16.6%->20.8%; extra warps overlap the MD5-ARX + RC4-KSA dep-latency chains. +15.7% (1109.3->1283.9), selftest PASS, value-identical (alloc-only). Occupancy lever was UNTRIED (prior 3 experiments all op-count/algebraic); corrects the transferred-from-m9800 "near roofline" claim. Next: sweep minBlocks 9/12/16.

m9700 a3 __launch_bounds__ minBlocks 10->12 (occ 20.8->25%, ~170 regs/thread): 1284.1 vs best 1283.9 = +0.2 mhs = FLAT (within ~1-2% noise). Occupancy sweep past 10 blocks/SM yields no further latency-hiding gain -- either ptxas spills at ~170 regs (cut from ~204) offsetting the extra warps, or 10 warps already saturate the benefit for this MD5-ARX+RC4-KSA dep chain. minBlocks=10 remains the sweet spot; occupancy lever now bounded above at 10. (16 blocks/33% occ would cut to ~128 regs -> heavier spill, lower EV.)

m9700 a3 __launch_bounds__ minBlocks 10->9 (occ target 20.8%->18.75%, regs cap ~204->~227): 1341.4 vs best 1283.9 = +4.5% beyond noise, selftest PASS. Lower occupancy but less register trimming wins; minBlocks=9 is new best, while prior minBlocks=12 was flat.

m9700 a3 single-hash early reject: decrypt only the first word of the final RC4 block and skip the remaining 12 bytes on mismatch; full RC4 and comparison remain for first-word matches. Value-identical, selftest PASS, but 1345.2 vs best 1341.4 = +0.28%, within ~1-2% noise; final PRGA tail is too small a runtime fraction and branch/helper effects offset the saved work.

m9700 a3 single-hash: stage 19 invariant salt-alignment words once/workgroup in 76B shared and force on-demand volatile broadcast loads, replacing long-lived per-thread registers. Value-identical and selftest PASS, but 1235.5 vs best 1341.4 = -7.9%; added shared-load latency/barrier outweighs register-lifetime savings (cached baseline already 168 regs).
